cname_records.title: Cname Records
cname_records.description: A map of objects where each object contains information to create a CNAME record.
cname_records.tfType:
map(object({
    name                = string
    resource_group_name = string
    zone_name           = string
    ttl                 = number
    record              = string
    tags                = optional(map(string), null)
    target_resource_id  = optional(string)
  }))
